Package io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.processor.model

Record Class ParameterModel

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.projectunified.craftcommand.processor.model.ParameterModel
Record Components:
name - the parameter name
type - the Java type of the parameter
enumConstants - the constants when the type is an enum, otherwise null
greedy - whether the parameter consumes all remaining arguments
optional - whether the parameter has a default value
defaultValue - the default value, or null
suggestProvider - the suggestion provider name, or null
suggestField - whether the suggestion provider names a field
resolveName - the raw @Resolve value, or null
resolverMethod - the linked resolver method, or null
suggestMethod - the linked suggestion method, or null
element - the underlying parameter element
public record ParameterModel(String name, TypeMirror type, List<String> enumConstants, boolean greedy, boolean optional, String defaultValue, String suggestProvider, boolean suggestField, String resolveName, MethodModel resolverMethod, MethodModel suggestMethod, VariableElement element) extends Record
Model representing a command method parameter.

All annotation-derived facts are resolved once at parse time: the resolver declared by @Resolve and the suggestion provider declared by @Suggest are linked here, so code generation never re-reads the core command annotations. SPI handlers still read their own annotations.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
